title: 2026年6月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 Music is a universal language. In every culture and country, you will find music. It is vitally important across the globe and has the potential to bring people together in peace and harmony. One of my favorite experiences in music is seeing musicians from different cultures come together and perform as a group. When each culture brings its own unique qualities to the group, an entirely new sound is achieved. This can create extraordinary results. People can communicate with each other using music as the common language.

P2 One common musical thread between cultures is known as the pentatonic scale. It is astonishing how many cultures share this tool in approaching music. The pentatonic scale consists of five notes; "penta-" meaning 5, and "tonic" meaning tone or note. This scale can be found in music everywhere including that of Native Americans, Africans, and Asians. It is also found in popular music, blues, jazz, and rock. Using this five-note scale, musicians from around the globe have a medium through which they can relate, communicate, perform, and ultimately understand each other.

P3 Music is tied to specific perceptual(感知的), mental, and emotional faculties, including language (all societies put words to their songs), motor control (people in all societies dance), sound analysis (all musical systems have a distinct pitch and quality), and aesthetics(美感) (their tunes and rhythms are balanced between repetitiveness and chaos).

P4 There is no known society that existed without music. Although each culture has their own specific style and approach to music, you will find that the purposes behind music are very similar across the board. Music essentially serves to express or change emotions. It can cheer you up, sadden you, anger you or excite you. Music is often ceremonial: used in religion, ceremony, and celebration. Music can simply be recreational: entertaining, joyful and fun. Any way you have used music, it is almost certain that every other culture has used music in the very same way. And that is something that bonds all of us. We all share a deep love for music and it has the power to unite us.

questions.q: In what way is music important?
options: It is able to create novel and extraordinary emotions.
It has the power to unite people throughout the world.
It allows different cultural groups to sing in harmony.
It is the only language favored by all peoples of the world.
questions.explain:
【判型】In what way is music important? 用 In what way 询问音乐重要性的具体表现，属于对文 中具体信息的考查。

【拆句】In what way is music important? 为简单疑问句，主干是 music is important，In what way 询问方式或方面，无否定、比较等陷阱。 51. In what way is music important? A) It is able to create novel and extraordinary emotions. B) It has the power to unite people throughout the world. C) It allows different cultural groups to sing in harmony. D) It is the only language favored by all peoples of the world.

【定位】It is vitally important across the globe and has the potential to bring people together in peace and harmony. 音乐在全球范围内都极为重要，并且有可能将人们凝聚在一起，实现和平与和谐。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 选项 It is able to create novel and extraordinary emotions 把原文 This can create extraordinary results 中的 extraordinary results 偷换为 extraordinary emotions， 并新增 novel，改变了原文对象。 B) ✓ 正确 has the potential to bring people together ↔has the power to unite people across the globe ↔throughout the world 原文说音乐有潜力将全球人民凝聚在和平与和谐中，It has the power to unite people throughout the world 用 power 替换 potential，unite 替换 bring together， throughout the world 替换 across the globe，整体语义完全一致。 C) 过度推断 原文 bring people together in peace and harmony 中的 harmony 是比喻性的和平 和谐，选项 It allows different cultural groups to sing in harmony 把它具体化为 '唱 歌和谐'，并添加 sing，属于过度具体化。 D) 过度推断 原文 Music is a universal language 只说音乐是通用语言，并未说它是 the only language favored by all peoples of the world，only 与 favored 均无出处。 作者为什么喜欢观看来自不同文化背景的音乐家一起表演？ A) 他们的音乐经历可以进行比较。 B) 可以创造出一种新的语言。 C) 他们独特的技能可以得到展示。 D) 可以取得奇妙的成果。

questions.q: Why does the author like to see musicians from different cultures perform together?
options: Their musical experience can be compared.
A novel language can be created.
Their unique skills can be displayed.
Fantastic results can be achieved.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why does the author like to see musicians from different cultures perform together? 用 Why 询问作者喜欢某现象的原因，属于因果类细节题。

【拆句】Why does the author like to see musicians from different cultures perform together? 为 why 引导的特殊疑问句，主干是 the author likes to see musicians perform together，无复杂从句。 52. Why does the author like to see musicians from different cultures perform together? A) Their musical experience can be compared. B) A novel language can be created. C) Their unique skills can be displayed. D) Fantastic results can be achieved.

【定位】One of my favorite experiences in music is seeing musicians from different cultures come together and perform as a group. When each culture brings its own unique qualities to the group, an entirely new sound is achieved. This can create extraordinary results. 我在音乐中最喜欢的经历之一，就是看到来自不同文化的音乐家聚到一起、作为一个团体表 演。当每种文化都为这个团体带来自己独特的特质时，一种全新的声音就产生了。这能创造 出非凡的成果。

【选项】A) 无中生有 选项 Their musical experience can be compared 提出 '比较经历'，但原文 P1 只描述 作者喜欢观看这种表演，未涉及比较。 B) 偷换概念 原文 an entirely new sound is achieved 说的是产生全新声音，选项 A novel language can be created 把 sound 偷换为 language。 C) 偷换概念 原文 each culture brings its own unique qualities to the group 强调文化特质被带入 团体以创造新声音，选项 Their unique skills can be displayed 把 qualities 窄化为 skills，并把 brings 改为 displayed，重心从 '共同创造' 偏移为 '展示个人技能'。 D) ✓ 正确 This can create extraordinary results. ↔Fantastic results can be achieved. an entirely new sound is achieved ↔Fantastic results can be achieved. 作者喜欢跨文化合作的原因在 This can create extraordinary results，Fantastic results can be achieved 用被动语态和 fantastic 同义改写 create extraordinary results，准确回答原因。 文章对五声音阶作了怎样的说明？ A) 它存在于世界各地的音乐中。 B) 它有助于理解音乐。 C) 它是音乐家创作的基础。 D) 它是普通人与之建立联系的一种媒介。

questions.q: What does the passage say about the pentatonic scale?
options: It is present in music all around the world.
It is helpful to understanding music.
It is the basis for musicians' creation.
It is a medium for ordinary people to relate.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the passage say about the pentatonic scale? 直接问文中关于某对象的具体 说法，属于典型细节题。

【拆句】What does the passage say about the pentatonic scale? 为 what 引导的特殊疑问句， about 的宾语 pentatonic scale 是定位核心，结构简单。 53. What does the passage say about the pentatonic scale? A) It is present in music all around the world. B) It is helpful to understanding music. C) It is the basis for musicians' creation. D) It is a medium for ordinary people to relate.

【定位】This scale can be found in music everywhere including that of Native Americans, Africans, and Asians. It is also found in popular music, blues, jazz, and rock. 这种音阶可以在世界各地的音乐中找到，包括美洲原住民、非洲人和亚洲人的音乐。它也存 在于流行音乐、蓝调、爵士乐和摇滚乐中。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 This scale can be found in music everywhere ↔It is present in music all around the world. including that of Native Americans, Africans, and Asians ↔ It is present in music all around the world. 原文 This scale can be found in music everywhere 与 It is present in music all around the world 语义完全等值，仅表达方式不同。 B) 过度推断 原文 musicians from around the globe have a medium through which they can relate, communicate, perform, and ultimately understand each other 说的是音乐 家相互理解，选项 It is helpful to understanding music 把对象扩大为 '理解音乐'，范 围过宽。 C) 过度推断 原文 a medium through which they can relate 说五声音阶是交流的媒介，选项 It is the basis for musicians' creation 把 medium 提升为 basis for creation，夸大了其 地位。 D) 偷换概念 原文 musicians from around the globe have a medium through which they can relate 的主体是 musicians，选项 It is a medium for ordinary people to relate 把主 体换成 ordinary people。 音乐在人们生活中的根本作用是什么？ A) 将人们团结在一起。 B) 展示他们的身份。 C) 表达他们的情感。 D) 使他们保持愉悦。

questions.q: What is the fundamental role of music in people's life?
options: To bring them together.
To show their identity.
To express their emotions.
To keep them entertained.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the fundamental role of music in people's life? 用 What is the ... role 询问音 乐的根本作用，属于细节题。

【拆句】What is the fundamental role of music in people's life? 为 what 引导的特殊疑问句，of music in people's life 是后置定语，修饰 role，结构平铺直叙。 54. What is the fundamental role of music in people's life? A) To bring them together. B) To show their identity. C) To express their emotions. D) To keep them entertained.

【定位】Music essentially serves to express or change emotions. 音乐本质上用于表达或改变情绪。

【选项】A) 答非所问 原文 has the potential to bring people together 与 it has the power to unite us 确 实是音乐的作用，但题干问的是 fundamental role，答案应是 essentially serves to express or change emotions，A 项答非所问。 B) 无中生有 选项 To show their identity 提出 '展示身份'，但原文从未提到 identity 或相关概念。 C) ✓ 正确 Music essentially serves to express or change emotions ↔To express their emotions. 原文 Music essentially serves to express or change emotions 中，express or change emotions 是音乐的本质功能，To express their emotions 提取了其中 express emotions 这一核心，对应 fundamental role。 D) 以偏概全 原文 Music can simply be recreational: entertaining, joyful and fun 提到娱乐是音乐 的用途之一，但选项 To keep them entertained 把它提升为根本作用，忽略了 express or change emotions 的核心地位。 世界各地的音乐在哪一方面相似？ A) 人们对它作出反应的方式。 B) 它在社会中所发挥的作用。 C) 它带给人们的快乐。 D) 人们利用它的方式。

questions.q: In what aspect is music similar throughout the world?
options: The way people respond to it.
The role it plays in society.
The joy it brings to people.
The way it is made use of.
questions.explain:
【判型】In what aspect is music similar throughout the world? 用 In what aspect 询问全球音 乐相似的具体方面，属于细节题。

【拆句】In what aspect is music similar throughout the world? 为 in what aspect 引导的特殊 疑问句，主干是 music is similar，throughout the world 限定范围，无复杂结构。

【定位】Although each culture has their own specific style and approach to music, you will find that the purposes behind music are very similar across the board. Any way you have used music, it is almost certain that every other culture has used music in the very same way. 尽管每种文化都有自己独特的音乐风格和处理方式，但你会发现音乐背后的目的总体上是 十分相似的。你使用音乐的任何方式，几乎可以肯定其他文化也以完全相同的方式使用过 音乐。 55. In what aspect is music similar throughout the world? A) The way people respond to it. B) The role it plays in society. C) The joy it brings to people. D) The way it is made use of.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文 every other culture has used music in the very same way 说的是 '使用' 音乐的 方式相同，选项 The way people respond to it 把它改为 '回应' 音乐的方式，动作性质 改变。 B) 以偏概全 原文 the purposes behind music are very similar across the board 强调使用目的/ 方式相似，选项 The role it plays in society 把它扩大为 '社会角色'，范围过宽且未突出 '方式'。 C) 以偏概全 原文 Music can simply be recreational: entertaining, joyful and fun 提到 joy 是娱 乐用途的一部分，选项 The joy it brings to people 把它提升为音乐全球相似性的方 面，范围过窄。 D) ✓ 正确 the purposes behind music are very similar across the board ↔The way it is made use of. every other culture has used music in the very same way ↔The way it is made use of. 原文指出不同文化音乐的目的和使用方式非常相似，The way it is made use of 准确概 括了 purposes behind music 与 used music in the same way 两者。
